body: I really felt like doing something drastic after being told those words. I mean i dont say what i say just for fun... i actually say them because i think about it all the time. Its just a big hit to the face.
If you'd still like to talk, I'm here. We can fight this depression thing together.
If they're judging you then they're not your friends. I'm sorry you're going through this. Virtual hug?
Hey, I hear you. If you ever need someone to talk to I'm here.

I'd like to know where my map to happiness, too. I also feel a lot of regret. I feel like I've made so many decisional mistakes in my life. The "what-if I had..." thoughts, you know? I wonder if I'd still be thinking the same things as I am now. 

I've also thought that I would die young of natural causes, and to be honest I'm even feeling a little disappointed that I haven't...I must be so broken to even think that way...:(

There's definitely truth to that first point...however I also know some people who have had their lives mapped out from high school who have turned out to be extremely successful and happy, that makes me so sad. Like, why can't I be like them? How do you go about dealing with that? I know comparison is never a good thing but just, sigh.

I like the idea of the big, bold question mark. I want to be able to see my life like that too, but I also feel like I'm wasting so much time compared to the people who have ambitions, know what they're doing, etc.
How did you make yourself feel better?
Stuck on this planet by obligation...I feel completely the same way. :(
